menu.main.title: Bardia
menu.main.tagline: A saga of oar, sail and kin on the Whale-Road

menu.newSaga.contentErrorBody: The game’s content did not pass its checks, so a saga cannot begin. The problems are listed below.
menu.newSaga.intro.identity: Who rises from the ashes of the Broken Feast?
menu.newSaga.intro.homeland: Which shore raised you? Each homeland has its gifts and its burdens.
menu.newSaga.intro.parentage: Your parent the Jarl was slain at the feast. Which one?
menu.newSaga.intro.upbringing: How were you raised? It sharpens one skill and may leave a mark.
menu.newSaga.intro.skills: Spend your skill points. Bonuses from upbringing, homeland and traits come on top.
menu.newSaga.intro.attributes: Every attribute starts at four. Spend your points.
menu.newSaga.intro.trait: Choose a virtue. You may also accept a flaw for extra skill points.
menu.newSaga.intro.difficulty: How hard the North will be, and the rules of this saga.
menu.newSaga.issue.nameChars: Names use letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes.

menu.newSaga.identity.name: Name
menu.newSaga.identity.sexNote: Sex changes only portraits and forms of address. Every system is the same.
menu.newSaga.parentage.lede: The survivor joins your household as counsellor, and may act as regent or marry again.
menu.newSaga.parentage.fatherDesc: Your father fell at the Broken Feast. Your mother survives, grim-eyed, to counsel you.
menu.newSaga.parentage.motherDesc: Your mother fell at the Broken Feast. Your father survives, grey and bitter, to counsel you.

menu.newSaga.option.ironmanHint: A single save, written for you. No going back.
menu.newSaga.option.gentleModeHint: No child deaths; you are captured rather than killed in duels.
menu.newSaga.option.duelAssistHint: Duels start in the turn-based Assisted Mode.
menu.newSaga.option.harshWintersHint: Longer ice, fiercer storms, leaner stores.
menu.newSaga.option.bloodHint: Show blood in battles and duels.

menu.options.audio.narrationHint: Narration lines are voiced where a voice exists.
menu.options.gameplay.autoPauseNote: Decisions always stop time. Choose what else pauses the voyage.

menu.options.access.previewBody: Gulls quarrel over the fish-racks. Your Hirdmaster waits at the hall door with a face like a wet Thunday.

menu.credits.title: Credits
menu.credits.lede: Bardia is an original saga, made for one player and a long winter.
menu.credits.body.engineering: The owner, with a fellowship of AI builders
menu.credits.body.writing: The owner and the skalds of the build
menu.credits.body.testing: Everyone who sails before the fleet is finished
menu.credits.placeholderBody: Every image, tune and voice you meet in this build is generated on the fly. Each one has a place reserved for the final work, which replaces it without any change to the game.
menu.skirmish.title: Skirmish
menu.skirmish.intro: Fight one battle on its own: no saga, no consequences. Pick a match-up.
menu.skirmish.preset.raid.title: Raid on a village
menu.skirmish.preset.raid.body: Your war-band lands below a farming village. Plunder the halls and get the silver aboard before the horns call the countryside.
menu.skirmish.preset.field.title: Battle in the open
menu.skirmish.preset.field.body: Two armies on open ground: shield walls, archers and horsemen. Break their line before they break yours.
menu.skirmish.preset.assault.title: Assault on a walled town
menu.skirmish.preset.assault.body: Palisade, gates and a garrison. Bring the ram to a gate or burn it, then take their chief.
menu.skirmish.preset.cloister.title: Cloister raid
menu.skirmish.preset.cloister.body: A walled cloister with its guards and monks. Break into the reliquary and carry off its treasure.
